description: Make an image from a prompt. Charged to the user's Leaxor credits (10–30 credits depending on the model; list_models has each price). Most models finish within a minute and the image URL comes straight back. Slower models return an id instead: call get_image with it. Pass reference_images (https URLs) to edit or restyle a photo on models that accept them.

aspect.description: Shape of the image. Defaults to 9:16.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to flux-2-pro.

reference_images.description: Optional https image URLs to edit or follow.

style.description: A style preset added to the prompt. Defaults to cinematic.

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
